defect: The fix only renames pressedLastFrame to pressedLastUpdate because update() can run at sub-frame intervals.
reason: A pure variable rename with no behavioural change repairs no defect.

defect: The fix adds null-pointer asserts and nulls buf_ after the deferred delete in VKFramebuffer as paranoia after a crash report.
reason: Dropping the unused vulkan_ member from VKFramebuffer creates no defect; the fix is defensive checking around destructor code written later.

defect: The fix replaces the Blackberry readdir_r workaround by giving readdir_r a padded dirent buffer, because QNX's struct dirent is too small for d_name.
reason: The undersized-dirent overflow already existed in the generic path before this change; the added workaround only copied the same readdir_r into a plain struct dirent.

defect: The fix reorders UIUpdateMouse so mousedown is updated before mouseframesdown is counted, and raises the scroll-start threshold from 10 to 15 pixels.
reason: The update order lives in pre-existing UIUpdateMouse code, and the 10-to-15 change is threshold tuning, not a correctness repair.

defect: The new wait loop runs when progress is null (!progress is true) and then dereferences progress->cancelled, and it never checks whether cancelled itself is null, so it segfaults.
reason: The null dereference sits in the loop condition the change rewrote, and the fix repairs exactly that.

defect: The fix casts the light type to int and uses int case labels, because very old Adreno drivers reject a switch over unsigned integers.
reason: The switch over a uint type already existed in the ubershader before this change, which failed to compile on GLES before this change anyway; the change only made the labels conformant, and the old-driver limitation predates it.

defect: Scheduling now relies on threadReadyQueue, but the added ReSchedule code marks the running thread ready before the interrupt/callback early returns, and the queue is maintained wrongly in __KernelSwitchContext, so the thread state goes inconsistent.
reason: The fix moves the block this change added in __KernelReSchedule and corrects the ready-queue bookkeeping that __KernelNextThread, rewritten here, now depends on.

defect: The change relabels the Savestate Slot submenu accelerator from F3 to F2, which duplicates the Quick Save F2 label on the next line and shows the wrong shortcut.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the F2 typo this change introduced.

defect: The fix restricts 'using tr1::is_pointer' in namespace std to Android, because it broke the Linux build.
reason: The using-declaration came from the earlier Android buildfix 7a36619; this change only excluded Apple and left Linux unchanged.

defect: The fix adds LL suffixes to the -2147483648 and 2147483647 literals in trunc.w.s to silence a 32-bit warning about unsigned negation.
reason: The comparison still gave the right result, because the int converts to the same unsigned or long long value, so the fix is warning cleanup.

defect: The fix renames the abgrN locals to argbN in the YUV conversion loop.
reason: A cosmetic variable rename with no behavioural effect.

defect: The fix changes sceKernelSelfStopUnloadModule's parameters to (exitCode, argSize, argp), following JPCSP.
reason: This change only renamed the function; the wrong four-argument signature already existed under the old name.

defect: The new StringFromFormat call for GE_PROJMAP_NORMALIZED_NORMAL has two %s but passes one argument, which is undefined behaviour and can corrupt the generated shader.
reason: The format string with a missing argument was added by this change, and the fix removes the extra %s.

defect: The added SeekFile in npdrmLseek moves the file to data_offset+newPos, which is not block-aligned, and passes the caller's whence with an absolute position, so npdrmRead's next whole-block read decrypts misaligned data.
reason: The fix changes this added seek to the block start (and also seeks per block in npdrmRead), so the wrong offset in the added line is what it repairs.

defect: The fix widens the settings buttons and moves the description text and control checkboxes, after the i18n strings arrived.
reason: Cosmetic layout spacing, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix rewrites parseLBN to accept sce_lbn names with or without 0x, using %x%n parsing.
reason: The fixed-offset erase that assumes 0x predates this change, which only added warnings on sscanf failure.

defect: The fix guards the savestate read of decoder->GetAudioType() when decoder is null.
reason: The unguarded decoder dereference in DoState existed before; this change only added an int cast to it.

defect: GPU_SUPPORTS_INSTANCE_RENDERING is set only for EXT_gpu_shader4, so GLES3 and desktop GL 3.1+ contexts, which support gl_InstanceID natively, are wrongly reported as unable to use instanced hardware tessellation.
reason: The fix widens exactly the feature-detection condition this change added.

defect: The fix changes the forward declaration from class to struct GPUDebugBuffer to silence a class/struct mismatch warning, and reformats the declaration.
reason: This is a warning and style fix with no reported functional failure.

defect: The fix removes the Reload Cheats option and the Android exclusion of the cheats section.
reason: This is a UI/feature decision, not a repair of a defect in the moved block.

defect: The fix stops 32-bit builds from aliasing VRAM mirror views to the previous view when they differ in the low address bits.
reason: The MV_MIRROR_PREVIOUS aliasing (with its TODO) was moved unchanged from Common/MemArena.cpp, and the VRAM mirrors predate this change.

defect: Callers pass row_pitch_bits as texbufwidth*8, treating the texel buffer width as bytes, so every non-8-bit texture format gets the wrong row and block stride.
reason: The old code had the right units (width*texel_size_bits), and the fix multiplies the new pitch by texel_size_bits/8 in both formulas this change introduced.

defect: The fix forwards GLES_GPU::Resized() to framebufferManager_, because resized_ was no longer consumed.
reason: The breakage came from the later commit 64a3765, which moved framebuffer management into its own file; in this change resized_ was handled in CopyDisplayToOutput.

defect: The fix translates the Rendering Resolution submenu from the DesktopUI i18n category instead of Graphics.
reason: The graphics category on that line predates this change, which only added the Ctrl+1 accelerator to it.

defect: The fix corrects the self-comparison newHeight > newHeight (and newHeight*2 < newHeight) to compare against bufferHeight.
reason: The wrong condition was copied verbatim from GPU/GLES/Framebuffer.cpp, where it already existed before this centralizing move.

defect: The fix sets the stencil ops in the upload loop to GL_REPLACE instead of GL_KEEP, so the stencil bits are actually written.
reason: The queued render_->SetStencil calls already passed GL_KEEP ops before this change, so the stencil was already left unwritten; this change only split the call into SetStencilFunc and SetStencilOp.

defect: The fix enables the Qt desktop UI and debug menus on all non-ARM platforms, not only Linux, along with build-file changes.
reason: This extends a deliberate platform restriction once the other platforms could build the desktop UI; it is a feature enablement.

defect: The fix replaces Choice widgets with Buttons (with icons) for a new look.
reason: A cosmetic UI restyle.

defect: The new locals mouseDeltaX and mouseDeltaY are declared without initialization and are read in the mouse-axis code before any motion event sets them.
reason: Reading these uninitialized floats is undefined behaviour introduced by this change, and the fix initializes them to 0.

defect: The fix extends space stripping to the nickname and ProAdhocServerScreen inputs and splits the existing call into a temporary.
reason: The StripSpaces call this change added was correct; the fix extends the same feature to other inputs.

defect: The fix implements ModuleMgrForKernel_a1a78c58 as a load-module wrapper so 'tiger x dragon' stops crashing.
reason: The change added a new module table with an unimplemented stub; the fix implements a function that was never implemented.

defect: The fix gives GE_CMD_COLORTESTMASK FLAG_EXECUTEONCHANGE so the color-mask uniform is actually dirtied, and drops the handler from GE_CMD_COLORTEST.
reason: COLORTESTMASK lacked an execute flag before this change too, so its handler never ran either way; this change only attached a function pointer.

defect: Integer scaling always snaps outW to multiples of 480, which is wrong in portrait orientation, where the displayed width is 272.
reason: The added integer-scale block ignores the rotated flag computed in the same function, and the fix adds exactly that case.

defect: The fix changes the YES/NO selection rectangle colour from 0x65636358 to 0x40C0C0C0.
reason: A cosmetic colour tweak to match the PSP look, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix swaps the Square/Triangle entries in dinput_ctrl_map and switches the special-button hack on the mapped keycode instead of the raw button index, so it survives remapping.
reason: The inverted X/Y mapping was in the pre-existing table, and with the current table switching on from or to gives the same result.

defect: The rewrite tests writability on the exe directory (path) but deletes the test file from memstickpath, so the memstick folder is never checked and a stray test file is left behind; it also swaps the wide GetModuleFileName path for the ANSI GetExeDirectory.
reason: The fix changes the CreateEmptyFile target added by this change to memstickpath and restores a Unicode exe path.

defect: The fix wraps File::GetExeDirectory() in ConvertWStringToUTF8, because the same fix commit changed GetExeDirectory to return a wide string.
reason: The line is adapted to an API change; the encoding problem lay in the pre-existing ANSI GetExeDirectory, not in this caller.

defect: In this file the fix only extracts the light-control bit packing into PackLightControlBits() so other backends can reuse it.
reason: The change in this file is a pure refactor; the D3D11/OpenGL ubershader fixes are in other files.

defect: The fix adds a right margin of 6 to the game grid layout params.
reason: A cosmetic margin adjustment.

defect: The fix passes false instead of 1.0f as the third TextView argument, after the native TextView signature changed to a bool.
reason: At this change's native revision the third argument was a float textScale, so 1.0f was correct; the fix adapts to a later API change.
